headline: Settlement gain flatters profit as sales and margins soften
summary_short: Net sales fell 3.2% y/y to $1.38 billion and gross margin dropped to 42.6% from 45.4%. Reported net income rose to $183 million (diluted EPS $0.90) almost entirely on an $88 million settlement gain and a $62 million tax benefit -- adjusted diluted EPS fell to $0.32 from $0.49.
summary_long: Net sales declined 3.2% y/y on fewer North American transactions, partly offset by higher average dollar sales; international sales grew. Gross margin fell to 42.6% from 45.4% on tariff, inflation and commodity cost pressure plus category mix and deleverage from lower sales. Operating income rose 10.4% to $231M and net income rose to $183M, but both gains were driven by an $88M interchange-fee litigation settlement, not underlying performance -- adjusted operating income fell to $151M and adjusted diluted EPS fell to $0.32 from $0.49. The company repurchased and extinguished $284M of senior notes; no share repurchases occurred. Capex guidance for full-year 2026 was held at approximately $270M. Dividend held at $0.20/share.

drivers.explanation: North American Net Sales fell on a decrease in transactions, partially offset by higher average dollar sales; International and Other Net Sales increased.
Merchandise margin rate declined primarily due to tariffs, inflation and crude oil impacts as well as category mix, plus Buying and Occupancy deleverage on lower Net Sales.

Gain was primarily due to lower G&A and store operating expenses from an $88M pre-tax gain on payment-card interchange fee litigation settlements, partially offset by lower sales and gross margin rate.

Reported gain reflects the same $88M settlement plus a $62M tax benefit from resolution of certain tax matters (effective tax rate -10.1% vs 28.4%); adjusted net income (excluding one-offs) fell to $65M from $105M.

Company frames results around its multi-year 'Consumer First Formula' transformation plan; management says early response is 'consistent with our roadmap' with impact expected to build through 2026 into 2027.
